en.headline: Police investigate suspected arson at Chuk Yuen South Estate
en.dek: A curtain hanging on a flat door in Fu Yuen House caught fire; the case has been classified as arson with no injuries reported.
body: Police are investigating a suspected arson after a curtain hanging on the door of a flat in Fu Yuen House at Chuk Yuen South Estate in Wong Tai Sin caught fire.
The incident was reported to police at 10.36pm on Monday. Fire services personnel attended and later classified the cause as suspicious, leading to the case being treated as arson.
The Wong Tai Sin district criminal investigation team is handling the case. No injuries were reported and no arrests have been made.

zh.headline: 竹園南邨單位大門布簾起火 警方列作縱火調查
zh.dek: 黃大仙竹園南邨富園樓一個單位大門上的布簾起火，消防初步懷疑有可疑，警方列作縱火案跟進，無人受傷。
body: 警方正調查一宗懷疑縱火案。黃大仙竹園南邨富園樓一個單位大門上掛有的布簾起火。
事件於星期一晚上10時36分報警。消防到場處理後，初步認為起火原因可疑，警方遂列作縱火案調查。
案件由黃大仙警區刑事調查隊跟進，事件中無人受傷，目前未有人被捕。
